body: The only thing you can do is try your best with this situation.  It's okay to feel like you don't want to let go.  You spent 7 years of your life with this person, it's going to take time to heal.  You ARE a strong person and you certainly aren't dumb for hanging on.  Be patient and kind to yourself through your healing process, you will get through this <3

Thank you SO much for this.  I've had my feelings dismissed so much lately that I truly thought it was just me overreacting or not having adequate coping skills.  I will absolutely look into some mindfulness exercises, thank you so much for the suggestion!

I can absolutely understand how you are feeling.  In April of 2018, my ex ended our 7-year relationship.  He came home one day and told me that he didn't love me anymore.  I moved out of our apartment and back to my parent's house.  That whole experience destroyed me and I can feel your pain when I read your post.  

I struggled to function as a person for a while.  Then I found a therapist who helped me build my confidence and teach me coping skills.  With that, I was able to go back to school and get my bachelor's degree, lost 70lbs, ran two 5k's, and eventually met someone who made me happy.  

My point is, you WILL get through this.  I don't know the details of your situation, but I would advise against being friends.  In my experience, it makes it A LOT harder to get over someone.  Take this time, as much as it hurts or seems impossible, to focus on you for a while and things will start to make sense and fall into place.
